description_full: PDD Holdings Inc., a multinational commerce group that owns and operates a portfolio of businesses. The company operates Pinduoduo platform, which provides various product categories and interactive shopping experiences; and Temu, an online platform, which enables merchants to streamline their manufacturing and commercial operations. The company was formerly known as Pinduoduo Inc. and changed its name to PDD Holdings Inc. in February 2023. PDD Holdings Inc. was incorporated in 2015 and is based in Dublin, Ireland.
ceo_bio: Mr. Lei  Chen | General Counsel, Co-CEO & Co-Chairman of the Board | Age 45
culture_narrative: Employs approximately 25K people. Revenue per employee of $2.5M ranks in the top quartile among Consumer Cyclical peers, improving at 63%/yr — growing workforce leverage. Stock-based compensation of $47K per employee reflects an ownership culture.
financial_summary: PDD Holdings Inc. is a large-cap consumer cyclical business with a $118.2B market cap on $64.8B of annual revenue.
The top line has compounded at +46% over the past three years, the kind of sustained demand persistence that marks a compounder.
Gross margins of 77% are the starting point for assessing pricing power.
On the balance sheet, the balance sheet carries net cash, which is the gold standard: the business never has to make desperate decisions in a bad year.

Shareholder yield is only 0.0%, a thin return of capital, and insider ownership is negligible, so management has little personal stake in the long-term outcome, and within its sector the business captures 2.6× its fair share of profits, a structural advantage visible in the numbers.
